input: Get a notarized letter for my landlord dispute

gold.taskTitle: Get a Notarized Letter for Landlord Dispute
gold.taskDescription: The user needs to obtain a notarized letter to support or resolve a dispute with their landlord.

questions.title: What is the dispute specifically about?
questions.description: Understanding the nature of the dispute (e.g., security deposit, repairs, eviction, lease terms) will shape what the letter needs to say.

questions.title: Who is writing and signing this letter?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user is writing it themselves, having a witness write it, or requiring a lawyer or third party to author it.

questions.title: What is the deadline for submitting this letter?
questions.description: Knowing the due date will determine how urgently the notarization needs to be arranged.

questions.title: Who specifically is the letter addressed to?
questions.description: Identify whether it is addressed to the landlord directly, a property management company, a court, or a housing authority.

questions.title: Do you already have a draft of the letter?
questions.description: Knowing whether a draft exists helps determine if the next step is writing, reviewing, or going straight to notarization.

questions.title: Have you used a notary service before?
questions.description: This establishes familiarity with the process and helps determine whether guidance on finding a notary is needed.

questions.title: Is this dispute heading toward legal action or court?
questions.description: Understanding whether this is a formal legal matter will affect the required format, language, and urgency of the notarized letter.
